description: Source file for the AppDelegate implementation in a WebKit-based macOS application, managing application lifecycle, window creation, web view configuration, and delegate methods.

classes.name: WebViewDialog
classes.description: A simple dialog wrapper for WKWebView JavaScript dialogs, handling memory management and callback execution.

classes.name: BrowserAppDelegate
classes.description: Main application delegate handling app setup, window creation, web view configuration, and delegate methods for navigation, dialogs, and downloads.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the app delegate, processes command line arguments, and sets headless mode if specified.

methods.name: awakeFromNib
methods.description: Configures touch bar support on app activation.

methods.name: proxyConfiguration:WithBypassList:
methods.description: Creates a proxy configuration dictionary based on provided server and bypass list.

methods.name: persistentDataStore
methods.description: Creates and returns a persistent WKWebsiteDataStore configured with local directories and proxy settings.

methods.name: defaultConfiguration
methods.description: Provides a default WKWebViewConfiguration with specific preferences and process pool settings.

methods.name: applicationDidFinishLaunching:
methods.description: Handles application startup, creates initial web page, and manages headless or headful modes.

methods.name: _updateNewWindowKeyEquivalents
methods.description: Sets keyboard equivalents for menu items related to new window commands.

methods.name: sessionConfiguration:
methods.description: Returns a configuration for a web view session identified by session ID.

methods.name: createNewPage:
methods.description: Creates a new WKWebView for a session, defaulting to about:blank.

methods.name: createNewPage:withURL:
methods.description: Creates a new WKWebView with a specific URL.

methods.name: createHeadfulPage:withURL:
methods.description: Creates a visible WKWebView embedded in a window, loading a URL.

methods.name: createHeadlessPage:withURL:
methods.description: Creates an off-screen WKWebView for background processing, loads URL if provided.

methods.name: createBrowserContext:WithBypassList:
methods.description: Creates a new browser context with its own data store and process pool.

methods.name: deleteBrowserContext:
methods.description: Removes a browser context based on session ID.

methods.name: quit
methods.description: Terminates the application.

methods.name: webViewDidClose:
methods.description: Handles WebView close events, cleaning up dialogs and windows.

methods.name: _webView:getWindowFrameWithCompletionHandler:
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the window frame for a WebView.

methods.name: webView:runJavaScriptAlertPanelWithMessage:initiatedByFrame:completionHandler:
methods.description: Displays alert dialogs triggered by JavaScript.

methods.name: webView:runJavaScriptConfirmPanelWithMessage:initiatedByFrame:completionHandler:
methods.description: Displays confirm dialogs triggered by JavaScript.

methods.name: webView:runJavaScriptTextInputPanelWithPrompt:defaultText:initiatedByFrame:completionHandler:
methods.description: Displays prompt dialogs for JavaScript with input.

methods.name: _webView:runBeforeUnloadConfirmPanelWithMessage:initiatedByFrame:completionHandler:
methods.description: Handles beforeunload confirmation prompts.

methods.name: webView:handleJavaScriptDialog:value:
methods.description: Completes pending JavaScript dialogs with user response.

methods.name: webView:createWebViewWithConfiguration:forNavigationAction:windowFeatures:
methods.description: Creates a new WebView for pop-ups or new windows.

methods.name: webView:decidePolicyForNavigationAction:decisionHandler:
methods.description: Decides whether to allow, download, or handle navigation actions.

methods.name: webView:decidePolicyForNavigationResponse:decisionHandler:
methods.description: Decides whether to display or download content based on response headers.

methods.name: webView:navigationAction:didBecomeDownload:
methods.description: Handles download action for navigation.

methods.name: webView:navigationResponse:didBecomeDownload:
methods.description: Handles download for navigation response.

methods.name: _webView:requestStorageAccessPanelForDomain:underCurrentDomain:completionHandler:
methods.description: Automatically grants storage access for the domain request.

methods.name: download:decideDestinationUsingResponse:suggestedFilename:completionHandler:
methods.description: Handles download destination decision. Currently does not specify a location.
